newsitem.title: CHILE: Chile's Aninat says 5.5 pct inflation goal assured.
newsitem.headline: Chile's Aninat says 5.5 pct inflation goal assured.

text.p: Chile's Finance Minister Eduardo Aninat said Tuesday that the target of finishing 1997 with annual inflation of 5.5 percent is assured.
"Annual inflation is already below six percent and falling fast. We think that the target is now completely assured," Aninat told reporters.

Aninat said that the latest economic growth figures, showing expansion of only 3.5 percent in March and 3.9 percent in the first quarter, showed that Central Bank moves to slow down the economy were taking effect.
But the Chilean economy should rebound in the second half, and growth for the whole year should be from 5.5-6.0 percent, Aninat said.
